name: Pinning Shot
prompt:
Create one finished AshenSpire card artwork illustration. Style reference ONLY: attached image; do not copy its knight into unrelated cards. Exact card identity: Pinning Shot (pinningShot), rogue attack. Canonical action: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {weak} Weak. [{"op":"damage","target":"enemy","amount":6},{"op":"applyStatus","target":"enemy","status":"weak","stacks":1}]. Lore/mood: An arrow through the hem, not the heart.

Dock archers learned it on the gulls first, then on the Court's bailiffs, whose long coats caught on every piling. A pinned bailiff is a patient one.

The docks still tell which bailiff wore the longest coat, and laugh.. Illustrate that specific action or concept clearly in a grounded ruined medieval dark fantasy world. For rogue cards use a weathered hooded agile rogue and correct weapons; equipment technique must depict the named weapon (unarmed means empty hands, bow means bow and arrow, staff means a long magical staff, sceptre a short ritual focus). Single coherent scene, anatomically correct hands and physically plausible weapons. Rich painted material detail, dramatic readable lighting, ash, old stone, worn iron, muted earth with appropriate restrained magical color. Composition portrait 2:3, 1024x1536. Main focal action below the upper third, with ample detailed background/sky/ruins ABOVE and around it for user repositioning and mouse cropping. Avoid subject clipping and excessive closeup.
